name: Mobi Order Numbers
author: mobiplugin

sections.description:
Give every order a sequential number customers and staff can recognize.

  • Prefix, date, padding, suffix
  • Reset daily, monthly, or yearly
  • Live format preview
  • Tools to renumber existing orders
  • Works with WooCommerce HPOS
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate and open the Order Numbers settings.
  3. Set the format, Save, then place a test order.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Text domain matches wordpress.org slug. Admin redirects use wp_enqueue_script / wp_add_inline_script.

1.0.0

  • First public free release.
